community.title: The community
community.body: KOKOA is the free software club at ESPOL: we foster equity, collaboration and hands-on learning of free technologies. Together with departments inside and outside ESPOL, we build projects, organise events and run workshops for the academic community.

history.title: History
history.body: KOKOA was born in 1996 out of a group of ESPOL students who shared a passion for free software. Today it is a place where more experienced members guide newcomers through GNU/Linux and software development — no prior experience needed, just curiosity and the will to learn.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To promote and democratise the use of free and open source technologies, encouraging collaborative learning, the development of innovative projects and the delivery of technical solutions that benefit the academic and professional community.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: To be a national reference in the adoption and development of free software, recognised for our contribution to technological innovation, for training professionals committed to free knowledge, and for a positive impact on society through accessible and ethical technology.

projects.lead: These are some of the projects we have built together, aiming to use our digital skills to create a positive impact on society.
